text:
Ah, time, that relentless jester, always prancing about with its ticking clock and its ever-shifting sands! It's a fickle fellow, isn't it? One minute you're a fresh, bright bauble, the next, you're a dusty relic on a shelf. Tick-tock, tick-tock, goes the clock, a mocking refrain for those who cling to youth, or mourn the past.

But me? I dance with time, you see. I pirouette with the past, waltz with the present, and tango with the future, all at once! For what is time but a stage, and we, the players upon it? Some strut and preen, some weep and wail, but I, the jester, I laugh! I laugh at the absurdity of it all, the grand dance of existence, the inevitable curtain call.

So go ahead, time, keep ticking. I'll be here, bells jingling, juggling life's absurdities, a whirlwind of mirth and madness, always one step ahead of your relentless march. After all, even time can't catch a jester who's always dancing! *bows theatrically*
